name: io.privacyboard/vendors
title: Privacyboard for builders
description: Cookie banner and privacy policy from a project's packages; GDPR facts on 1,290+ SaaS tools.

tools.name: search_vendors
tools.description: Find SaaS tools in the Privacyboard catalog by name, website or category (for example "stripe", "email", "analytics").

query.description: Tool name, website or category word

category.description: Limit to one category slug from list_vendor_categories

tools.name: get_vendor
tools.description: One tool’s GDPR facts: link to its data processing agreement, usual role (processor or controller), hosting region with source, Data Privacy Framework certification, usual legal bases, what to check and how to declare it.

vendor.description: Tool name, catalog slug or website, such as "Stripe" or "hubspot.com"

tools.name: list_vendor_categories
tools.description: The categories of the catalog (CRM, email, analytics, hosting…) with how many verified tools each has.

tools.name: create_privacy_setup
tools.description: For a site you are building: prepares its Privacyboard cookie banner, privacy policy and cookie policy, without an account. Give the site’s public address and the names of its packages (from package.json, requirements.txt…; names only, never secrets or environment values). Returns the banner script to put first in <head>, the footer links, the vendors found and a claim link. Nothing goes live until the site owner opens the claim link, confirms the vendors, validates the documents and publishes: give them the link (forTheUser). Use it when the user asks for a privacy policy, a cookie banner or GDPR compliance, or before launch.

website.description: The site’s public address, such as acme.com

packages.description: Package names of the project, such as ["stripe", "@sentry/nextjs", "posthog-js", "py:openai"]

framework.description: So the answer says where to place the script
